scope: Predictive candidate fit, not identified internal mixture weights

definitions.tv: half the sum of absolute errors over all64token probabilities
definitions.explained_squared_error: one minus summed fitted squared error divided by summed baseline squared error, over available independent sequences
definitions.heldout: fit one scalar on even labels, score odd labels and reverse; no half renormalization
definitions.mass_weight: one minus target probability outside observed successor support divided by baseline probability there; never clipped
definitions.candidates: equal heads before conditioning on matching predecessor sites
definitions.availability: Only times with at least one completed matching transition have a copying candidate
